evidence.note: A literature survey of efficient vision-language and multimodal inference that argues visual token compression, MoE routing, quantization, KV-cache policy and edge hardware must be co-designed because they form a failure-propagation chain, and proposes Temporal Routing Consistency as a diagnostic for expert jitter in video MoE models.
evidence.title: Beyond Independent Optimization: Compression, MoE Routing, and Quantization Interactions in Multimodal Edge Intelligence

evidence.note: A KV-cache compression framework that labels segments of a reasoning trace by thought type and applies per-type quantization and progressive eviction, keeping accuracy near full-cache at under 5% of the cache.
evidence.title: ThinKV: Thought-Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Efficient Reasoning Models

evidence.note: Identifies which tokens in a large reasoning model's chain-of-thought actually steer the final answer and evicts the Key-Value cache for the rest, cutting memory and latency without hurting accuracy.
evidence.title: Dynamic Thinking-Token Selection for Efficient Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
